title: Integrate the official Warframe status API (api.warframestat.us) as a live world-state and reference-data source
authority_required: operator instruction, 2026-09-12: refactor the whole kad-warframe project to also use the official Warframe API data (docs.warframestat.us, github.com/WFCD/warframe-status)
scope: an API client with a local cache and explicit TTLs, offline-degrading to the last observation and never inventing a live fact

world state as a first-class source: cycles (Cetus/Vallis/Cambion/Duviri/Zariman/Earth), fissures, invasions with their rewards, Nightwave acts, Baro Ki'Teer, sortie, Archon hunt, arbitration, daily deals, construction progress
the official drop tables (/drops) cached locally and searched offline, so `build` and `item` cite the game's own published drop data
`kad-warframe world` with text and JSON output, plus plan actions for time-bound opportunities that expire, each carrying its expiry and observation time
curated requirements for world systems (data/world.json) with sources and a verification date, following the existing quests.json pattern
a World panel in the dashboard (WP-002), and world-state freshness reported by `check` without letting an unreachable live source fail an account-data check
non_scope: reimplementing account-snapshot acquisition: warframe-helper owns the memory scan and the mobile-API fetch
rivens, wfinfo and other late-game endpoints that cannot yet apply to this account
downloading images, thumbnails or any remote asset: the dashboard stays local-first (ISA-KAD-AESTHETIC-001)
letting the API become authoritative for account facts (mastery, inventory, credits): those stay snapshot-derived
advising from a stale world observation: when the live source is unreachable, time-bound advice is withheld rather than shown with an old timestamp
acceptance_criteria: `kad-warframe world` reports cycles, fissures, invasions, Nightwave and the trader from live data, with each entry's expiry and the observation time
plan actions for world opportunities state their expiry, and none are emitted when the world observation is stale
fissure advice matches the relics the account actually holds (tier mapping verified in curated data with sources)
`build` and `item` cite official drop-table entries where the table has them, labelled as such, falling back to the cached WFCD datasets and saying so
the API client is offline-safe: a failed fetch degrades to the last cached observation marked stale, and a missing cache reports UNKNOWN rather than fabricating state
the suite stays hermetic: fixtures captured from real responses, no network in tests, no live calls
evidence records the endpoints used, the cache TTLs, the degradation path and one real observation
